title: He Lives
lyrics_original: I know that He is living,
I see His hand of mercy,
I hear His voice of cheer,
And just the time I need Him
He walks with me, and talks with me
He lives! He lives, salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives:
In all the world around me,
And though my heart grows weary
I know that He is leading
He walks with me, and talks with me
He lives! He lives, salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives:
Lift up your voice and sing
The hope of all who seek Him,
The help of all who find,
He walks with me and talks with me
He lives, He lives, salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives:

bible_verses.english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being a living Savior who is with me today and every day. Forgive me for the times I look for You in distant places instead of recognizing Your gentle voice right beside me. Open my heart to see Your hand of mercy in my routine moments and to hear Your words of cheer when I am weary. Walk with me today, and let the joy of Your resurrection overflow in my life. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The resurrection is more than a past historical event; it is a present reality that fills our daily lives with hope. Jesus is not distant—He actively walks beside us, offering His mercy, comfort, and steady guidance whenever we need Him most. Even when the world questions or doubts, we can anchor our hearts in His faithful, abiding presence. Today, take joy in knowing that your Savior is alive, listening, and walking with you through every step.
